hero.title:
Cooked over fire,
served with care.
hero.text: Seasonal plates from oak and embers, natural wine and a room that glows.

steps-story.title:
How we
cook
steps-story.text: Three things we have never changed since the first night in 2014.

items.title: One oven, one rule.
items.text: Everything that leaves our kitchen has met the fire. We light the oven at noon with English oak, and it sets the pace for the whole day.

items.title: Close to the farm.
items.text: Our vegetables come from two farms in Kent, our fish from day boats in Cornwall. The menu changes when they do.

items.title: A room to stay in.
items.text: Candles, brick and a long communal table. Come for one plate at the bar or stay for the whole night.

items.title: Ember lamb chops
items.text: Salsa verde, charred lemon. £24

items.title: Burrata flatbread
items.text: Blistered tomatoes, oregano. £16

items.title: Charred broccoli
items.text: Tahini, chilli, toasted seeds. £11

items.title: Whole sea bass
items.text: Fennel, brown butter. £29

items.title: Smoked chocolate tart
items.text: Crème fraîche. £9

cards-menu.title: Tonight's menu
cards-menu.text: Menus change with the season. Tell us about allergies when you book.

items.title: Small plates
items.text: Sourdough and cultured butter, smoked almonds, ember carrots, burrata flatbread.

items.title: From the fire
items.text: Ember lamb chops, whole sea bass, half chicken, aged rib-eye for two.

items.title: Sweet
items.text: Smoked chocolate tart, burnt honey ice cream, roasted plums with custard.

items.title: Drinks
items.text: Natural reds, orange wine from Georgia, an oak-smoked old fashioned.

stats-fire.title:
Ten years of
oak and embers

items.label: The night we lit the oven

visit-private.title:
The long table
is yours.
visit-private.text: Up to 24 guests around our oak table, with a set menu cooked for your night. Birthdays, team dinners, rehearsal suppers.

items.text: The lamb is the best thing I ate all year, and the room is somewhere you want to stay.
items.name: Hannah L.

items.text: We booked the long table for forty minutes of dinner and stayed four hours.
items.name: Dev P.

items.text: Honest cooking, warm people. Exactly what a neighbourhood place should be.
items.name: Marta K.

visit-find.title: Come hungry
visit-find.text: Two minutes from Shoreditch High Street station. Walk-ins welcome at the bar.

finale.title:
See you
at the fire
finale.text: We hold tables for fifteen minutes. For groups over eight, ask about private dining.

hero.title:
Stay where the
tide sets the time
hero.text: Twenty-two rooms carved into the cliff, a stone spa, long lunches on the terrace and the bay below.

gallery-rooms.title: Twenty-two rooms, each facing the water

items.title: Sea View Suite

items.title: Garden Room

items.title: Beam Loft

items.title: Cliff Villa

facts-house.title:
Built from the
island's own stone
facts-house.text: Quietly restored, the house keeps its old rhythm: shutters open with the light, lunch is long and nobody hurries.

items.title: Stone Spa
items.text: A candlelit pool cut into the rock, with island salt and oils. Open daily 9 to 21.

items.title: Terrace Kitchen
items.text: Fish from the morning boats and vegetables from our garden. Lunch and dinner.

items.title: Hidden Coves
items.text: Our wooden boat takes you where only the water goes. Tuesdays and Fridays.

Close to everything,
far from it all
